name: 旅行画布
description: Plan and continue a shared trip across stays, transport, dining and experiences.
description_zh: 在同一份旅行中比较机酒、安排吃住行玩，核对每次修改，保存偏好并关注价格。
description_en: Compare stays and transport, review itinerary changes, remember preferences and watch prices.
examples_zh: 打开我保存的旅行，继续比较酒店
换一家酒店，先核对对路线和预算的影响
examples_en: Open my saved trip and compare hotels.
Preview a hotel change and check routes and budget.
